components.name: Adjoint boundary pullback calculus
components.project_addition: Reinterpret established left/right adjoint structure as the exact reverse-time transport law for declared future principal threshold boundaries. Generalize canonical P024 translation cuts B-M to finite boundary pullback orbits under explicit adjoint action witnesses; connect P008 integer roots, quotients and perfect-power collapse to the same calculus; prove finite recursive compilation/stabilization, preserve the task-relative nonmonotone exception, and record the split-preimage no-go where scalar boundary rank fails. Generic future-safe quotient theory remains P023-owned and the underlying Galois-connection mathematics is not claimed as novel.
